hens_rule_text: Poultry only on lots of at least 20,000 sq ft in the RR, HR, R-1, RA-2 and AG zones, up to 15 birds per 20,000 sq ft. Typical smaller subdivision lots in other residential zones cannot keep chickens.
permit_notes: The zoning code table lists poultry as permitted in the qualifying zones and no chicken permit was found; confirm with the Planning Division (951-413-3206).
setback_notes: Area where animals are housed must be at least 20 feet from any habitable dwelling; 0 feet from side and rear lines; front yard uses the district requirement. Coops and sheds also follow accessory structure setbacks in 9.08.030.
coop_rules: Housing area must meet the animal setbacks; waste removal rules of Chapter 6.04 apply.
zoning_notes: Roosters, guinea fowl and peafowl are banned citywide. The city's zoning FAQ says chickens are regulated by zoning and lot size and points to Table 9.09.090-11.
hoa_note: Homeowners associations, deed restrictions and leases can be stricter than city law. Check yours before getting chickens.

sources.name: Moreno Valley Municipal Code 9.09.090 Agricultural and animal uses

research_notes: Code text of 9.09.090 read via an Internet Archive copy (Jan 2024) of the former qcode edition, current through Nov 2023; the code has since moved to eCode360, which could not be opened. A 2025 petition sought small-lot flocks but no adopted change was found; permit status not stated in the code.
